correctness.rationale: Independent reconstruction from seven XOR Fano lines yields face counts (7,21,28,7), boundary ranks 15 and 7 and 28-15=13 two-cycle rank. Exhaustive 28-choose-at-most-six mod-2 search gives cycle supports (0,0,0,7,0,42). The seven weight-four supports are distinct tetrahedral boundaries; the source proof explains why even-coefficient external triangles cannot hide shorter nontrivial integral cycles. Every weight-six support uses exactly five vertices and corresponds to a five-point set and one of its two contained lines. Rebuilt all 42 bipyramidal integral cycles: B2 kills each, their 28x42 matrix has rank 13 and thirteen unit Smith invariants, so its saturated column lattice equals the full integral cycle kernel. Independent GL3(F2) computation gives 168 automorphisms, transitive on all 42 supports. Each primitive class follows also from single orbit plus saturated spanning. H1=0 integrally follows from explicit missing-line fillings or unit Smith factors of B2; B3 boundaries are disjoint supports. Finite enumeration is exhaustive only for 28 actual triangles, not generalized planes.
